messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER (P1) - inference latency spike in eu-west-1. Error rate up; p95/p99 token latency elevated >5s. Paging oncall-sre. thread 1765554321
laura: I'm oncall and joining the war room. @dan can you pull recent deploys/logs? I'll take incident lead unless anyone objects.
dan: Joining now. War room link: https://zoom.redwood.ai/j/123456789?pwd=ops (pinned)
emily: Quick triage: QPS looks steady but token latency and KV cache miss rate spiking ~10:18 UTC. No recent model swaps in hosted; checking runtime patches.
sam: Copy. Assigning owner: laura. @statusbot please draft a short status update for status.redwood.ai (partial degradation).
statusbot: Draft ready: "Customers in EU may experience increased response times for text generation. Engineers are investigating; mitigation in progress." Visibility suggested: Partial degradation. Post?
laura: Post. Add: "Suspected KV cache regression after yesterday's runtime patch."
dan: Mitigation attempt: enabling fallback routing + scaling dedicated pool for eu-west-1. Also initiating rollback of runtime patch: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/redwood-runtime --to-revision=42`
ops-bot: Rollback initiated by dan at 1765554500. Watchers: autoscaler triggered +2 nodes. ETA ~2m.
laura: On-call handoff plan: @michael will cover overnight escalation if needed. Michael, ack?
michael: Ack, standing by.
emily: Logs show worker pv-assistant-3 in CrashLoopBackOff; memory churn high. Restarting pod now.
sam: Notifying a handful of affected customers (enterprise tier) with short note linking to status page and support contact.
laura: Status update v1 posted to status.redwood.ai: Partial Degradation. Planned cadence: update every 10m or on major change. Owner: laura. War room link pinned. Paging confirmed.
incident-bot: Incident record created INC-2026-1765554321. Severity: P1. Participants: laura, dan, emily, sam, michael.
dan: Quick pod snapshot:
```
$ kubectl get pods -n inference | grep pv-assistant
pv-assistant-1   Running           1/1
pv-assistant-2   Running           1/1
pv-assistant-3   CrashLoopBackOff  0/1   (restarts=3)
```
Restarted pv-assistant-3; monitoring for stable startup.
laura: If latency doesn't improve within 5m of rollback, prepare customer bridge and escalation notes.
michael: I'll draft the customer comms template: 1) what happened 2) affected regions 3) current mitigation 4) contact for urgent support. Posting in #support shortly.
sam: Status page posted at 1765554600. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-1765554321
statusbot: Status entry live: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-1765554321 (updated by laura)
laura: Leaving war room to coordinate with support and customers; michael is backup owner for overnight. I'll update this thread with handoff note and incident doc link: https://redwood.infra/incidents/1765554321
ops-bot: Monitoring alerting: latency trending down after rollback+restart. Continue to observe for 15m before de-escalation.
laura: Thanks all — will post next update in 10m or on resolution.
